chats.answer:
A smart plug with a timer lets you automatically turn appliances on or off at scheduled times using your phone.

There are two useful timer features:

Schedule timer: Turn a lamp on at 6 PM and off at 11 PM every day.

Countdown timer: Automatically turn off a fan, charger, or other device after 30 minutes, 1 hour, etc.

For most people, I recommend a Wi-Fi smart plug with both scheduling and countdown timers, so you don't need a separate smart home hub.
